name: sanduhr-meters
description: Sanduhr's session and weekly meters above the prompt: bars with the pace mark, reset countdowns, your Style popover looks animated (sweep, shimmer, glow), Sanduhr's watchers as rows, and a toast when a limit nearly fills or the session resets. Reads only Sanduhr's snapshot.json and band.json on this machine.

bars.title: Meters
bars.description: Which meters the band shows: both, session or weekly.

style.title: Style
style.description: compact: one line. full: a line per meter with pace words and the reset time.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: on: a bar sweeps when it crosses a warning line, a limit about to reset shimmers, a nearly full one glows, a watcher waiting on you pulses (all still while macOS Reduce Motion is on). off: the band stays still.

label.title: Label
label.description: A name shown before the meters, for your eyes only (the snapshot never names the account). Empty shows none.
